tasks.label: Configure DeepPrint and evaluation app
args: $cmake = Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $cmakePath = if ($cmake) { $cmake.Source } else { 'build/dependencies/cmake/bin/cmake.exe' }; & $cmakePath -S . -B build/evaluator -G 'MinGW Makefiles' -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/mingw32-make.exe '-DFINGERPRINT_TEXTURE_WEIGHT:STRING=0.22' -DFINGERPRINT_DEEPPRINT=ON -DFINGERPRINT_FVC2004_ROI=ON -DFINGERPRINT_BUILD_GUI=ON -DFINGERPRINT_DEEPPRINT_REFERENCE_DIR=tests/fixtures/deepprint; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Build DeepPrint and evaluation app
args: $cmake = Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $cmakePath = if ($cmake) { $cmake.Source } else { 'build/dependencies/cmake/bin/cmake.exe' }; & $cmakePath --build build/evaluator --config Release --parallel; exit $LASTEXITCODE
